Container.Name: corsarr
Container.Overview: Media automation server in one static binary: searches your indexers, sends releases to your download client and files them into your library. Runs as nobody:users (99:100) with a read-only root filesystem and no capabilities. Before the first start: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/corsarr && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/corsarr
Container.Requires: The data share must be writable by nobody:users (99:100), as Unraid shares are by default.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and key file. Back this up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Downloads and library on one share, mounted at the same path in your download client so imports are hardlinks. Use ro for shadow mode.

Config.Name: GOMEMLIMIT
Config.Description: Soft Go heap limit; keep it below the memory limit.
